description: A Python script for generating app icons for various app stores (Google Play, App Store, Amazon). It resizes a base icon to multiple predefined sizes and organizes them into store-specific directories.

classes.name: Converter
classes.description: A class that handles icon generation for different app stores by resizing a source image into various predefined sizes and organizing them into store-specific directories.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, checks the source icon, and initiates the icon generation process.

methods.name: convert_to
methods.description: Resizes the source image to a specified size and saves it to the given filename.

methods.name: ensure_quality
methods.description: Checks if the source image has appropriate dimensions and quality for icon generation; exits if not and not forced.

methods.name: iterate
methods.description: Yields store directory names and size info for icon generation.
